q: Krieger's generator theorem states that an ergodic measure-preserving system (X,μ,T) has a generating partition of size k (a finite partition 𝒫 with ∨_{n=-∞}^∞ T^n𝒫 = ℬ) if:
exp: Krieger's theorem: an ergodic aperiodic system with entropy h(T) < log k has a generator of size k. In particular, any system with finite entropy has a finite generator. The minimum generator size is ⌈e^{h(T)}⌉ (Rokhlin-Sinai theorem).
